$comment: Contract for the AssignUserRole server-side command (AD-003, AD-041). Deployed via the registration console (plugins/OutcomeTesting.Registration) and added to the OutcomeTesting solution via a solution-file import. Custom API parameter Type codes: 0=Boolean, 10=String.

customApi.name: al_AssignUserRole
customApi.description: Administrator maps a person (work email, AD-010) to an application role (AD-041). Enforces the caller holds Manage on permission.manage, upserts al_userrolemapping idempotently and writes an immutable Audit Event.

requestParameters.name: UserEmail
requestParameters.description: Work email of the person to assign (AD-010).

requestParameters.name: AppRole
requestParameters.description: Built-in role label, e.g. Administrator or T&C Manager. Omit when RoleCode is supplied.

requestParameters.name: RoleCode
requestParameters.description: Optional. Stable al_role code for a custom role (AD-044). When supplied, it takes precedence over AppRole.

requestParameters.name: IdempotencyKey
requestParameters.description: Stable key for the intent; a replay returns the same mapping.

responseProperties.name: AuditEventId
responseProperties.description: Id of the Audit Event written.

responseProperties.name: Conflict
responseProperties.description: True when an optimistic-concurrency conflict was detected.
